checks_passed.what_was_verified: Every stated mass, mole and yield in Examples 1 and 2 was recomputed independently from the compound named in each step heading. Twelve of the twelve experimental steps close on the product side to within the rounding the printed significant figures allow, and the two failures the artifact reports are real and correctly located: line 548 prints 88.2 g (0.5 mol) Jodmethan, which implies 176.4 against 141.94 for CH3I, and line 563 charges 223.48 g of a substrate that line 561 isolated only 111.24 g of. Both carry the right flag, molar_mass_inconsistent and scale_discontinuity respectively, and neither number has been corrected in the record.

The sodium tungstate judgement call that the provenance sidecar explicitly asked A5 to re-examine was re-examined and holds. 27.47 g against 0.08 mol implies 343.4; anhydrous Na2WO4 at 293.82 would give 0.0935 mol, which prints as 0.09 and not the 0.08 the page shows, while Na2WO4 dihydrate at 329.86 gives 0.0833 mol, which prints as 0.08. The German at line 563 says only Natriumwolframat. Not raising molar_mass_inconsistent is correct, and both readings are carried in notes rather than one being chosen.

The Example 1 Step 9 yield of 100 per cent was re-examined. The transformation is an O to C acyl migration so substrate and product are isomers; 0.23 mmol allows 0.1014 g and the printed 0.1 g is 98.6 per cent of it, which rounds to the printed 100 per cent at the one significant figure both masses carry. Not raising mass_balance_implausible is correct, and the record says so rather than staying silent.

Step to step continuity was checked across all twelve experimental steps. Example 1 Step 3 is the only step that consumes more than the preceding step produced and it is flagged; Example 1 Steps 2, 4, 6 and 7 and Example 2 Step 1 each take a portion of the preceding output, and the artifact's stated reading of scale_discontinuity as exceeds rather than differs from is applied consistently across all six and documented in each record's notes.

Every number in Examples 1 and 2 was read off the rendered page images p045, p046, p047 and p049 and compared against the enriched markdown and against the artifact. All masses, volumes, molarities, percentages, temperatures, times and melting points transcribe correctly, including the awkward ones: 88.2 g (0.5 mol) Jodmethan, 15 to 20 degrees C, 1.5 d, 870 g 13 per cent hypochlorite, 300 W, 2 M and 5 M HCl. No unit was mishandled: 1.8 l and 1.5 l became 1800 and 1500 ml, 1.5 d became time_h 36.0, and every mol figure became mmol correctly.

Reflux was nowhere recorded as a temperature. Example 1 Steps 5, 6, 7 and 8 and Example 2 Steps 1 and 2 all carry heating_method reflux with temperature not_specified or with the separately stated numeric value, exactly as rule 9 requires. The 15 to 20 degrees C range at line 556 was not flattened to a point and was not put in conditions.temperature at all; it is carried in the acetyl chloride addition_profile because it is the addition temperature, which is the correct handling.

No condition reads like a default. atmosphere is null on all 21 records, nitrogen appears nowhere, pressure.type is not_specified on all 21, stirring.type is null on all 21, ph_value is null on all 21, and reactor_type is null on all 21. Every non-null condition traces to an explicit phrase in the German.

Every compound identifier in every record was matched against output/compounds.json. All 21 records join, with exactly one exception, cyanide source in Preparation Schemes Step 1, and that record correctly raises a1_missing_compound as rule 7 directs.

The key set of all 21 records is identical to the key set of the reference run runs/CN104292137A/output/reactions.json, so no enrichment or vector field leaked in and no required field is missing. id and reaction_uuid are present but are computed by finalise.py after A2, and they are present in the reference run too, so they are not a schema defect in the finalised file. reactant_smiles, smiles_source, product_smiles, product_smiles_source and canonical_rxn are null on all 21, and no molecular weight, formula or SMILES appears in any structured field.

Every enum-valued field was checked against its closed list in the A2 prompt. All 21 reaction_class values, 21 mechanism_type values, 21 scale values, 21 reaction_class_confidence values, 21 temperature.type values and 21 pressure.type values are inside their lists. All 214 tags are category:value with a lowercase snake_case ASCII value, every category is one of the 16 named, every value in the eight closed-list categories is inside its list, and no record repeats a tag.

Internal consistency was checked mechanically on all 21 records: is_complete is true exactly when validation_flags is empty, the cross_reference_unresolved field agrees with the flag, each record has exactly one compound with is_product true, product_name equals that compound's identifier, product_yield_pct equals that compound's quantity.yield_pct, and every entry of reactant_names appears in compounds.

Every compound and reagent name in the two experimental sections and in the schemes section was compared German against the EN line on the same line. No pair names different things. Natriumthiomethylat and sodium thiomethylate, Essigester and ethyl acetate, Methylenchlorid and methylene chloride, Kalium-tert-butylat and potassium tert-butoxide, Acetoncyanhydrin and acetone cyanohydrin, Peroxyessigsäure and peroxyacetic acid all agree, and the artifact follows the German in every case. translation_conflict is correctly absent from all 21 records.

The one naming anomaly in the document is in the German itself, not between German and English: line 601 heads Example 2 Step 2 with 3-Oxo-1-cyclohexenyl ... benzoesäure where the procedure beneath makes the enol ester, and line 578 prints benzoat for the same class of product in Example 1 Step 8. The EN line at 602 renders the German faithfully as benzoic acid. The artifact reproduces the printed German name byte for byte on Example 2 Steps 2 and 3, does not correct it, and carries molar_mass_inconsistent on both records with the numbers set out. That is the correct handling and I verified the arithmetic behind it: 0.51 g at 1.17 mmol implies 435.9, which is 434.89 for the ester C21H19ClO6S and not 340.78 for the acid.

All twelve linkage_confirmed true values were substantiated mechanically: in each case the named precursor record's product_name string is present among that step's non-product compound identifiers. The cross-section link Example 2 Step 1 to Example 1::Step 6 was checked in both directions and holds, and Example 1 Step 1 is correctly the only experimental record with a null precursor.

The claims, lines 900 to 1141, were read in full. Claims 1 to 7 are compound claims, 8 and 9 composition claims, 10 a method of controlling plants, and 11 to 13 use claims. There is no process-of-preparation claim, so the absence of any Claims record here is correct and is not a recall miss, even though the reference run CN104292137A does carry eight Claims records.

Every solvent, wash, quench and drying agent in the two experimental sections was checked line by line against the workup block. Hexamethylphosphoric triamide, ethyl acetate, 1,2-dichloroethane, methylene chloride, glacial acetic acid, dioxane, methanol, carbon tetrachloride, diethyl ether, n-heptane, cyclohexanol, tetrahydrofuran, dimethylformamide, acetonitrile and hexane are all present; every water wash, every MgSO4 drying and every rotary evaporation is present; the ice and concentrated hydrochloric acid quench at line 556 and the 2 M and 5 M acidifications are all present. No workup step in either example is missing from its record.

Rule 5 says the document contains at least two one-pot steps. Five were located and they are exactly the five the artifact marks is_one_pot true: Example 1 Steps 1, 7 and 8 and Example 2 Steps 1 and 2. Each has two sequential charges with no workup between them, each lists both transformations in one_pot_steps in document order, and each takes reaction_class from the final transformation. No numbered Schritt was wrongly split and none was wrongly merged.

procedure_text was checked against the source mechanically for all 21 records. Every sentence is a verbatim substring of the German, no IMAGE_EXTRACT span survives in any of them, and the two apparent mismatches are page-break joins at lines 569 to 574 and 376 to 381 where the record correctly stitches the two halves with the page marker removed. procedure_summary contains no digit on any of the 21 records, as rule 31 requires.

The tautomer diagram on page p006, which the vision pass reported at line 105 as ten empty reactions, was opened and is four tautomers of formula (I) linked by equilibrium arrows, not ten transformations. Its absence from reactions.json is correct: tautomerisation is not a synthetic step and has no value in the reaction_class enum.
